design_philosophy: Ultra-clean, minimal, airy. Lots of whitespace. Flat design with soft borders, absolutely no drop shadows on cards. Generous internal padding and large rounded corners.

components.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-10 shadow-none hover:shadow-none transition-none
components.buttons: bg-violet-600 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-violet-700 transition-colors inline-flex items-center justify-center
components.pills: inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium border
components.chat_header: bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-600 to-indigo-500 p-4 text-white flex items-center
components.chat_bubble_ai: bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-4 text-gray-800 max-w-[80%]
components.chat_bubble_user: bg-violet-600 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4 text-white max-w-[80%] ml-auto
components.avatar_initials: w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-lg

sections_guide.name: Navigation
sections_guide.details: Fixed top nav with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80). Minimal styling, centered links (Features, Demo, Pricing, Privacy), rounded 'Get Started' CTA. Logo is a purple circle with 'L' and text 'Letsm AI'.

sections_guide.name: Hero
sections_guide.details: Massive top padding. H1: 'Your Life, Simplified' with 'Simplified' in violet-to-indigo text gradient. Subtitle in text-xl text-gray-500. Feature pills underneath in pastel colors (e.g., bg-purple-50, bg-blue-50) with subtle borders. Followed by a right-aligned or centered floating hero_mockup image.

sections_guide.name: Features
sections_guide.details: Section title 'Powerful Features'. 3-column bento grid of flat cards. Each card has a soft colored circular icon, bold title, muted description. Zero box-shadows.

sections_guide.name: Advanced Features
sections_guide.details: Section title 'Enhanced Intelligence'. Similar to Features, but some cards have soft gradient backgrounds or header accents.

sections_guide.name: Live Demo
sections_guide.details: Full-width layout. Left side: chat interface mockup with purple gradient header, white background, showing message bubbles. Right side: stacked buttons/cards acting as scenario selectors.

sections_guide.name: Real Conversations
sections_guide.details: 2x2 bento grid. Each card acts as a mini chat mockup. Green action cards/labels for outcomes (e.g., 'Reminder set for 2:00 PM today').

sections_guide.name: Integrations
sections_guide.details: Two large cards side-by-side: Messaging and Calendar. Grid of platform items with icons inside. Use lucide-react or react-icons. Gray 'Soon' badges.

sections_guide.name: Testimonials
sections_guide.details: Grid of quotes. Use avatar_initials component with CSS gradient backgrounds (e.g., bg-gradient-to-br from-pink-400 to-orange-400) for profile pictures. Apply a fading opacity mask at the edges of the grid.

sections_guide.name: Privacy
sections_guide.details: Section title 'Your Privacy, Our Priority'. 2-column bento cards. 'Safety Guidelines' in an amber-tinted box (bg-amber-50 border-amber-200) with bullet points.

sections_guide.name: CTA / Stats
sections_guide.details: Section 'Ready to Simplify Your Life?'. Large gradient text. A grid below showing stats: 50K+ Users, 2M+ Tasks, 99.9% Uptime with massive numbers and subtle text.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: Must include data-testid on ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs). Format: kebab-case, role-based.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: Ensure buttons and links have distinct focus:ring states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React/React Icons.
STRICT RULE: Do NOT use drop shadows on cards (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, etc.). The design must be entirely flat with 1px borders (`border border-gray-200`).
STRICT RULE: Generous padding is required. Sections must have `py-24` or `py-32`. Cards must have `p-8` to `p-12`. Do not cramp elements.
STRICT RULE: Large border radius. Use `rounded-3xl` for cards, `rounded-full` for buttons.
Testimonial avatars MUST use CSS gradients with initials, do not use external placeholder images.
Use the specific text, headings, and features extracted from the crawl (e.g., 'Your Life, Simplified', 'Enhanced Intelligence').
Use standard HTML semantic tags + Tailwind for layouts, and customize Shadcn (if used) to remove all shadows and increase border radii.
Only use the provided media URLs. Never use placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
